limitations: Pyflakes F rules only; no style, import-sorting, complexity, bugbear, or formatter. The Section 4 Razor stays outside ruff, which cannot express a file-line cap.

No change to the project's own '# noqa: secret-scan' convention.
exclusions: tests/fixtures/ab_corpus holds deliberately defective detector fixtures; excluded by path.

phases: Declare the tool and its scope
